sections.title: Hospital Assignment
sections.description: During this course, D4 students participate in a two-week long hospital externship.

sections.title: Personalized Care Clinic III
sections.description: The Personalized Care Suite (PCare) patient care clinical course consists of ½ day rotations. D4 student doctors are assigned a panel of patient and provide comprehensive dental care for patients with disabilities (IDD), medical complexities (MCC) and HIV (ICC). D4 students will be assigned sessions to provide an initial virtual encounter visit with new patients prior to the patient’s inperson appointment.
